post.summary: Create PDF export for Commitment Contracts
post.description:
Creates a PDF export for a given Commitment Contract.
Note: This endpoint is currently only supported in Procore Zones US01 && US02.

parameters.name: commitment_contract_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Commitment Contract.

wbs_pdf_groups.description: Optional list of Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) segment group identifiers used to group the contract's line items in the generated PDF. Each entry is the string id of a WBS segment, optionally suffixed with a tier index (for example "123" or "123,0"). Omit to render line items without WBS grouping.

204.description: No Content. The PDF export was accepted and is being generated asynchronously. Poll the GET variant of this endpoint to retrieve the generated document once it is ready.

code.description: HTTP status in screaming snake case (like BAD_REQUEST)

reason_code.description: A machine-readable code that identifies the error specifically enough for the client to interpret what happened and take action.

Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"wbs_pdf_groups\":[\"123\",\"456,0\"]}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/commitment_contracts/%7Bcommitment_contract_id%7D/pdf", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

get.description:
Check the status of a PDF document generation for a Commitment Contract. While the PDF is still generating this returns 202 Accepted; once complete it returns a 302 redirect whose Location header points to the generated PDF document.
Note: This endpoint is currently only supported in Procore Zones US01 && US02.

parameters.name: commitment_contract_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Commitment Contract.

Location.description: The generation is complete, return location to the generated PDF document.

400.description: Bad Request, indicates that the generation was unsuccessful

code.description: HTTP status in screaming snake case (like BAD_REQUEST)

reason_code.description: A machine-readable code that identifies the error specifically enough for the client to interpret what happened and take action.

404.description: Not Found, job not found (PDF generation has expired, or never started).
